ios.desc: Hi, I'm Rivers Cuomo. Weezify is a a Spotify-like player for all of my demos (1975-2017). There are close to 3500 of them. You can follow curated playlists. You can create and share playlists of your own. You can even add your own demos. I made this app myself. It took me all of 2021 to make. I'm still tweaking it. I hope you enjoy it.

quotes.text:
Wait, no one remembers now? He once released a mobile app to stream Weezer songs, all written by himself. 
https://apps.apple.com/us/app/weezify/id1598140531
I'm glad he's still writing code so hard.
quotes.story_title: Rivers Cuomo is an active developer on GitHub
